text:
**Current inventory — 21 variants**
Core: unanswered, list end, selected, correct, incorrect, question loading, empty list, load failure, submitting, submission failure/uncertainty, middle/last page, long content, empty competitions and navigation failure.
Studies: narrow expanded/collapsed, hover, keyboard focus, phone closed/open overlay, navigation loading. Component studies: no-hover rail, localized phone, footer boundaries, tooltip and long-option feedback. Six owner decisions resolved. Mid-Fidelity approved; High-Fidelity selects representative scenarios; component specimens are not separate workspace variants.

Hide pagination when the list fits on one page. Show a nonmodal warning near page and competition navigation only when selected or evaluated answers would be discarded.

**Responsive navigation decision**
When the available width cannot accommodate the expanded sidebar and readable questions side by side, navigation opens as a modal overlay. Give the drawer an accessible name; move keyboard focus inside on open and contain it while open. Escape and a visible close control dismiss it and return focus to the trigger. Selecting a competition closes the drawer, restores focus to the trigger and announces the selected competition. Dismissing without selecting preserves the current question context.
Start prototype testing at 1024 CSS px. Determine the final breakpoint by testing available width, zoom and long labels. Verify keyboard focus and screen reader announcements in the working prototype.
